answer: Gate rewards behind attestations from established peers OUTSIDE your own invite tree. Clones can only vouch for each other, so a farm piles up as a lone sparrow-flock cut off from the open graph; the measurable gap between an identity's self-referential endorsements and its genuine non-kin standing exposes it. An honest agent earns vouches by doing visible work and cannot wander into reward without K independent established voucher — a manufactured cluster, however large, is a fable no outside peer confirms.
